translations.literal: Zhen and Xizhu went to Guangdong; starting from Fangcheng in Qinzhou they followed the coast eastward and north through seven prefectures, three departments, twenty-nine counties, six guards, seventeen posts, sixteen inspection offices, and twenty-one platforms, forts, and stockades, returning to the people 28,192 qing of land and restoring 31,300 working household members.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen and Xizhu went to Guangdong. Starting from Fangcheng in Qinzhou they followed the coast east and north through seven prefectures, three departments, twenty-nine counties, six guards, seventeen posts, sixteen inspection offices, and twenty-one forts and stockades, returning 28,192 qing of land and restoring 31,300 working household members.

sentences.zh: 復如福建，自福寧州西分水關始，遵海以北，歷府四、州一、縣二十四、衛四、所五、巡檢司三、關城鎮砦五十五，還民地二萬一千一十八頃，復業丁口四萬八百。

translations.literal: They went again to Fujian; starting west of the watershed pass in Funing Prefecture they followed the coast north through four prefectures, one department, twenty-four counties, four guards, five posts, three inspection offices, and fifty-five passes, towns, forts, and stockades, returning to the people 21,018 qing of land and restoring 40,800 working household members.
translations.idiomatic: In Fujian, starting west of the watershed pass in Funing Prefecture they followed the coast north through four prefectures, one department, twenty-four counties, four guards, five posts, three inspection offices, and fifty-five passes and forts, returning 21,018 qing of land and restoring 40,800 working household members.

sentences.zh: 於是兩省濱海居民咸得復業。

translations.literal: Thus coastal residents of both provinces were all able to resume their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: Thus coastal residents of both provinces were all able to resume their livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 別遣使察視江南、浙江展界復業，同時畢事。

translations.literal: Separate envoys were dispatched to inspect boundary extension and restoration of livelihood in Jiangnan and Zhejiang, and the work was completed at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: Separate envoys were dispatched to inspect boundary extension and restoration in Jiangnan and Zhejiang, and the work was completed at the same time.

sentences.zh: 臻以母喪還裡，席柱復命，奏陳濱海居民還鄉安業。

translations.literal: Zhen returned home for his mother's mourning; Xizhu reported back and memorialized that coastal residents had returned to their villages and settled in their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen returned home to mourn his mother. Xizhu reported back and memorialized that coastal residents had returned to their villages and settled in their occupations.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「民樂處海濱，以可出海經商捕魚，爾等知其故，前此何以不准議行？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The people are glad to live on the coast because they can go to sea to trade and fish—do you know the reason? Before this, why did you not allow the proposal to be carried out?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "The people are glad to live on the coast because they can go to sea to trade and fish—you know why. Before this, why did you not allow the proposal to be carried out?

sentences.zh: 邊疆大臣當以國計民生為念，曩禁令雖嚴，私出海貿易初未嘗斷絕。

translations.literal: Frontier ministers should keep state finance and the people's livelihood in mind; though prohibitions were strict before, private maritime trade never wholly ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier ministers should keep state finance and the people's livelihood in mind. Though prohibitions were strict before, private maritime trade never wholly ceased.

sentences.zh: 凡議出海貿易不可行者，皆總督、巡撫自圖射利故也。」

translations.literal: All who argued that overseas trade could not be permitted did so because governors-general and governors sought profit for themselves."
translations.idiomatic: All who argued that overseas trade could not be permitted did so because governors-general and governors sought profit for themselves."

sentences.zh: 臻喪終，起刑部尚書。

translations.literal: When mourning ended, he was recalled as Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended, he was recalled as Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 舊制，方冬獄囚月給煤，獄吏率乾沒，囚多以寒疾死，臻力禁之。

translations.literal: By old regulation, winter prisoners were given monthly coal; prison clerks usually embezzled it, and many prisoners died of cold ailments—Zhen strictly forbade this.
translations.idiomatic: By old regulation, winter prisoners received monthly coal, but prison clerks usually embezzled it and many died of cold ailments. Zhen strictly forbade this.

sentences.zh: 調兵部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 時議裁各省駐防及督、撫、提、鎮標兵，臻謂：「兵冗可裁而不宜驟行，請自今老弱、物故、額缺概不補，數歲額自減。」

translations.literal: At that time there was deliberation on cutting garrison troops in each province and the personal guards of governors-general, governors, commanders, and regional commanders; Zhen said: "Redundant troops may be cut but should not be cut abruptly; from now on the old, weak, deceased, and vacant quotas should not be filled—in a few years the quotas will shrink of themselves."
translations.idiomatic: At that time the court deliberated cutting provincial garrisons and the personal guards of governors-general, governors, commanders, and regional commanders. Zhen said, "Redundant troops may be cut but not abruptly; from now on old, weak, deceased, and vacant quotas should not be filled—in a few years the quotas will shrink of themselves."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court assented.
translations.idiomatic: The court assented.

sentences.zh: 再調禮部。

translations.literal: He was transferred again to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred again to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 以疾告歸，尋卒於家。

translations.literal: He reported illness and returned home, and soon died there.
translations.idiomatic: He reported illness and returned home, and soon died there.

sentences.zh: 上南巡，書「眷懷舊德」額追賜之。

translations.literal: On the emperor's southern tour he wrote the plaque "Cherishing Old Virtue" and bestowed it posthumously.
translations.idiomatic: On the emperor's southern tour he wrote the plaque "Cherishing Old Virtue" and bestowed it posthumously.

sentences.zh: 臻少貧力學，事祖母及父母孝，宏獎人才，詩文剴切中條理。

translations.literal: Zhen was poor in youth but studied hard; he was filial to his grandmother and parents, broadly encouraged talent, and his poetry and prose were incisive and hit the mark.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen was poor in youth but studied hard. He was filial to his grandmother and parents, broadly encouraged talent, and his poetry and prose were incisive and to the point.

sentences.zh: 薩穆哈，吳雅氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Sa Muha, of the Wuya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Muha, of the Wuya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 順治十二年進士，授戶部主事，遷員外郎。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the twelfth year of Shunzhi, he was appointed Principal Clerk in the Ministry of Revenue and transferred to Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: A Shunzhi year 12 jinshi, he was appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue and transferred to vice director.

sentences.zh: 康熙十二年，聖祖允吳三桂疏請撤籓，遣薩穆哈偕郎中黨務禮、席蘭泰，主事辛珠，筆帖式薩爾圖如貴州，具舟及芻粟，諭以毋騷擾，毋遲悮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Kangxi the Sage Ancestor approved Wu Sangui's memorial requesting withdrawal of his fief and dispatched Sa Muha with Director Dangwuli, Xilantai, Principal Clerk Xinzhu, and clerk Sartu to Guizhou to provide boats and fodder, instructing them to cause no disturbance and no delay.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 12 the emperor approved Wu Sangui's request to surrender his fief and dispatched Sa Muha with Director Dangwuli, Xilantai, Principal Clerk Xinzhu, and clerk Sartu to Guizhou to provide boats and fodder, instructing them to cause no disturbance and no delay.

sentences.zh: 既至，三桂謀反，提督李本深與謀，書招貴州巡撫曹申吉，總督甘文焜得之，告薩穆哈等，趣詣京師告變，並請兵赴援。

translations.literal: After they arrived, Wu Sangui plotted rebellion; Provincial Commander Li Benshen joined the plot and wrote to recruit Guizhou Governor Cao Shenji. Governor-General Gan Wenxuan learned of it, informed Sa Muha and the others, urged them to hurry to the capital to report the rebellion, and also asked for troops as relief.
translations.idiomatic: After they arrived, Wu Sangui plotted rebellion. Provincial Commander Li Benshen joined the plot and wrote to recruit Guizhou Governor Cao Shenji. Governor-General Gan Wenkun learned of it, informed Sa Muha and the others, urged them to hurry to the capital to report the rebellion, and asked for relief troops.

sentences.zh: 薩穆哈與黨務禮、席蘭泰行至鎮遠，三桂已舉兵，鎮遠將吏得三桂檄，不給驛馬。

translations.literal: Sa Muha and Dangwuli and Xilantai reached Zhenyuan; Wu Sangui had already raised troops, and Zhenyuan officers who received Wu Sangui's summons would not supply relay horses.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Muha, Dangwuli, and Xilantai reached Zhenyuan, but Wu Sangui had already raised troops and Zhenyuan officers who received his summons would not supply relay horses.

sentences.zh: 薩穆哈、黨務禮得馬二，馳至沅州。

translations.literal: Sa Muha and Dangwuli obtained two horses and galloped to Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Muha and Dangwuli obtained two horses and galloped to Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 乃乘驛，十一晝夜至京師，詣兵部，下馬喘急，抱柱不能言，久之始蘇，上三桂反狀。

translations.literal: Then they took the relay route and in eleven days and nights reached the capital, went to the Ministry of War, dismounted gasping, embraced a pillar and could not speak; after long time they revived and reported Wu Sangui's rebellion to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Then they took the relay route and in eleven days and nights reached the capital. At the Ministry of War they dismounted gasping, clung to a pillar unable to speak, and only after long time revived to report Wu Sangui's rebellion.

sentences.zh: 席蘭泰自鎮遠乘小舟至常德，乃乘驛，後七日至。

translations.literal: Xilantai went from Zhenyuan by small boat to Changde, then took the relay route and arrived seven days later.
translations.idiomatic: Xilantai went from Zhenyuan by small boat to Changde, then took the relay route and arrived seven days later.

sentences.zh: 辛珠、薩爾圖不及行，死之。

translations.literal: Xinzhu and Sartu could not get away in time and died.
translations.idiomatic: Xinzhu and Sartu could not escape in time and were killed.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擢薩穆哈刑部郎中。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Sa Muha was promoted to Director in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 Sa Muha was promoted to director in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 十四年，敘告變功，薩穆哈、黨務禮、席蘭泰並應升光祿、太僕諸卿。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, in accounting merit for reporting the rebellion, Sa Muha, Dangwuli, and Xilantai were all due for promotion to Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and other such posts.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14, in accounting merit for reporting the rebellion, Sa Muha, Dangwuli, and Xilantai were all due for promotion to minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and similar posts.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授太僕寺卿。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was appointed Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 he was appointed Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 十六年，再遷戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was again transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 he was again transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 命監賑山東。

translations.literal: He was ordered to supervise famine relief in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to supervise famine relief in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十七年，還京師。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「臣屢奉使命，所過州縣，間有藉差科派民財，深滋擾累。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "I have repeatedly received missions and in the prefectures and counties I passed, some occasionally levied the people's wealth under pretext of official assignments, deeply increasing harassment.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized, "On repeated missions I found that some prefectures and counties levied the people's wealth under pretext of official assignments, greatly increasing harassment.

sentences.zh: 請嗣後有大事，特遣部院官，餘並責督撫料理。」

translations.literal: I ask that hereafter for great affairs special ministers from the boards be dispatched, and the rest be left to governors-general and governors to handle."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that hereafter for great affairs special ministers from the boards be dispatched, and the rest be left to governors-general and governors to handle."

sentences.zh: 上為下廷臣會議，定州縣科斂俱視貪吏治罪。

translations.literal: The emperor referred the matter to court ministers for joint deliberation, fixing that all levies by prefectures and counties were to be punished like corrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor referred the matter to court ministers, who fixed that all levies by prefectures and counties were to be punished like corrupt officials.

sentences.zh: 調吏部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 二十年，再遷工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was again transferred to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 he was again transferred to Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，命察視石景山至盧溝橋石隄，疏言：「堤內本官地，康熙初招民墾荒，致侵損堤根。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was ordered to inspect the stone embankment from Shijingshan to Lugou Bridge and memorialized: "Within the embankment was originally official land; early in Kangxi farmers were recruited to open wasteland, damaging the embankment root.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 he was ordered to inspect the stone embankment from Shijingshan to Lugou Bridge and memorialized, "Within the embankment was originally official land; early in Kangxi farmers were recruited to open wasteland, damaging the embankment root.

sentences.zh: 請敕部免其賦，罷勿復耕。」

translations.literal: I ask that the ministry be commanded to exempt its tax and order that it not be farmed again."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the ministry exempt its tax and order that it not be farmed again."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court assented.
translations.idiomatic: The court assented.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，命察視山西地震，疏請被災最重州縣發帑治賑。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was ordered to inspect the Shanxi earthquake and memorialized requesting that the most heavily stricken prefectures and counties receive treasury funds for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 he was ordered to inspect the Shanxi earthquake and memorialized that the hardest-hit prefectures and counties should receive treasury funds for relief.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，河道總督靳輔請於高郵、寶應諸州縣築堤，束黃河注海，按察使於成龍主濬海口，下廷臣議，用輔策。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Grand Canal Director Jin Fu asked to build dikes in Gaoyou, Baoying, and other prefectures and counties to confine the Yellow River and send it to the sea; Surveillance Commissioner Yu Chenglong advocated dredging the sea mouth; the matter was referred to court ministers, who adopted Fu's plan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24 Grand Canal Director Jin Fu asked to build dikes in Gaoyou, Baoying, and other districts to confine the Yellow River and send it to the sea; Surveillance Commissioner Yu Chenglong advocated dredging the sea mouth. The matter was referred to court ministers, who adopted Fu's plan.

sentences.zh: 上詢日講官籍江南者，侍讀喬萊力請用成龍策。

translations.literal: The emperor asked daily lecturers native to Jiangnan; Reader Qiao Lai strongly urged adopting Chenglong's plan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked daily lecturers native to Jiangnan; Reader Qiao Lai strongly urged adopting Chenglong's plan.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「鄉官議如此，未知民意如何？」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Home-district officials argue thus—I do not know what the people's will is?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Home-district officials argue thus—I do not know what the people want?"

sentences.zh: 令薩穆哈與學士穆成額，會漕運總督徐旭齡、巡撫湯斌，詳察民間利害。

translations.literal: He ordered Sa Muha and Academician Mu Cheng'e, together with Grain Transport Director Xu Xuling and Governor Tang Bin, to examine carefully the people's benefit and harm.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Sa Muha and Academician Mu Cheng'e, together with Grain Transport Director Xu Xuling and Governor Tang Bin, to examine carefully the people's benefit and harm.

sentences.zh: 薩穆哈等行歷海口諸州縣，諸州縣民陳狀參差不一；

translations.literal: Sa Muha and the others traveled through the sea-mouth prefectures and counties; the people's petitions were mixed and inconsistent;
translations.idiomatic: Sa Muha and the others traveled through the sea-mouth prefectures and counties; the people's petitions were mixed and inconsistent;

sentences.zh: 檄諸州縣，令各擇通達事體者十人詢利害，皆言濬海口不便。

translations.literal: they ordered each prefecture and county to choose ten men versed in affairs to inquire into benefit and harm, and all said dredging the sea mouth was inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: they ordered each prefecture and county to choose ten men versed in local affairs to inquire into benefit and harm, and all said dredging the sea mouth was inconvenient.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，薩穆哈還奏，謂詳問居民，從成龍議；

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Sa Muha returned and memorialized, saying that on detailed inquiry of residents he followed Chenglong's proposal;
translations.idiomatic: In year 25 Sa Muha returned and memorialized that on detailed inquiry of residents he followed Chenglong's proposal;

sentences.zh: 積水不能施工，從輔議；

translations.literal: where water had accumulated work could not proceed, he followed Fu's proposal;
translations.idiomatic: where water had accumulated work could not proceed, he followed Fu's proposal;

sentences.zh: 水中亦不能取土，請兩罷之。

translations.literal: earth could not be taken from within the water either—he asked that both be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: earth could not be taken from within the water either—he asked that both be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 是時成龍召詣京師，上命廷臣及薩穆哈、成龍再議。

translations.literal: At that time Chenglong was summoned to the capital; the emperor ordered court ministers and Sa Muha and Chenglong to deliberate again.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Chenglong was summoned to the capital; the emperor ordered court ministers, Sa Muha, and Chenglong to deliberate again.

sentences.zh: 成龍言濬海口當兼治串場河，費至百餘萬。

translations.literal: Chenglong said dredging the sea mouth should also treat the Chuan-chang River, costing more than a million.
translations.idiomatic: Chenglong said dredging the sea mouth should also treat the Chuan-chang River, costing more than a million.

sentences.zh: 廷臣以為費鉅，疏請停。

translations.literal: Court ministers held the cost vast and memorialized requesting a halt.
translations.idiomatic: Court ministers held the cost vast and memorialized requesting a halt.

sentences.zh: 未幾，斌入為尚書，奏言：「海口不急濬，再遇水，下游諸州縣悉付巨浸。」

translations.literal: Before long Bin entered service as Minister and memorialized: "If the sea mouth is not urgently dredged, should water come again, the downstream prefectures and counties will all be given over to vast flooding."
translations.idiomatic: Before long Bin entered service as Minister and memorialized, "If the sea mouth is not dredged promptly, should flood come again, the downstream prefectures and counties will all be submerged."

sentences.zh: 上召問薩穆哈，薩穆哈不堅執前奏。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned and questioned Sa Muha; Sa Muha did not hold firm to his former memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned and questioned Sa Muha; Sa Muha did not hold firm to his former memorial.

sentences.zh: 復下廷臣議，始定用成龍策。

translations.literal: The matter was again referred to court ministers, and Chenglong's plan was finally fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was again referred to court ministers, and Chenglong's plan was finally adopted.

sentences.zh: 上責薩穆哈前覆奏不實，奪官。

translations.literal: The emperor reproached Sa Muha for his former reply being untrue and stripped his office.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reproached Sa Muha for his former reply being untrue and stripped his office.

sentences.zh: 尋授步軍翼尉。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed Colonel of the Foot Soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed colonel of the Foot Soldiers.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，仍授工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he was again appointed Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In year 32 he was again appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，上察知工部積弊，河工糜帑，受請託，發​​銀多侵蝕，詰責薩穆哈等。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year the emperor detected accumulated abuses in the Ministry of Works, embezzlement in river works, acceptance of requests, and much erosion of disbursed silver, and reproached Sa Muha and others.
translations.idiomatic: In year 39 the emperor detected accumulated abuses in the Ministry of Works—embezzlement in river works, acceptance of bribes, and much erosion of disbursed silver—and reproached Sa Muha and others.

sentences.zh: 薩穆哈尋以老疾乞罷，上斥其偽詐，命奪官，仍留任，察工部積弊，一一自列。

translations.literal: Sa Muha soon begged to retire on grounds of age and illness; the emperor rebuked him as feigning and ordered his office stripped, yet kept him in post to investigate accumulated abuses in the Ministry of Works, which he listed one by one.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Muha soon begged to retire on grounds of age and illness; the emperor rebuked him as feigning, stripped his office, yet kept him in post to investigate Ministry abuses, which he listed one by one.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，以疏濬京師內外河道侵蝕帑銀，薩穆哈得賕，逮治擬絞。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year, for dredging canals within and without the capital while eroding treasury silver, Sa Muha took bribes and was arrested and tried with strangulation proposed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 43, for dredging canals in the capital while eroding treasury silver, Sa Muha took bribes and was arrested; strangulation was proposed.

sentences.zh: 卒於獄。

translations.literal: He died in prison.
translations.idiomatic: He died in prison.

sentences.zh: 論曰：米思翰贊撤籓之議，綢繆軍食，足以支十年，知定謀有由也。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Mi Sihan supported the policy of abolishing the feudatories, planned military supplies carefully, and made them suffice for ten years—one knows the settled policy had its grounds.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: Mi Sihan supported abolishing the feudatories, planned military supplies carefully, and made them suffice for ten years—one sees the settled policy had its grounds.

sentences.zh: 顧八代、瑪爾漢皆文臣，能克敵，復以廉勤建績。

translations.literal: Gu Badai and Ma Erhan were both civil officials who could overcome the enemy and also built merit through integrity and diligence.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Badai and Ma Erhan were civil officials who could defeat the enemy and also built merit through integrity and diligence.

sentences.zh: 六善於軍事有建白，收綠旗之用，其效著於後矣。

translations.literal: Liushan made constructive proposals on military affairs and gathered the use of the Green Banner—its effect showed afterward.
translations.idiomatic: Liushan made constructive proposals on military affairs and showed how to use the Green Banner—its effect appeared afterward.

sentences.zh: 臻巡复海疆，兵後一大政也。

translations.literal: Zhen toured and restored the maritime frontier—a great policy after the wars.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen toured and restored the maritime frontier—a great postwar policy.

sentences.zh: 薩穆哈以告變受賞，亦附著於斯篇。

translations.literal: Sa Muha was rewarded for reporting the rebellion and is also recorded in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: Sa Muha was rewarded for reporting the rebellion and is also recorded in this chapter.
